from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,concurrent.futures,json,hashlib,re
out=Path.cwd()/'.work/builtin-minus-rot-20261116'

for kind in ('baseline','candidate'):
 for os,target in [('windows','x86_64-windows-gnu'),('linux','x86_64-linux-musl')]:jobs.append((kind,os+'-fast-build',['zig','build','-Dtarget='+target,'-Doptimize=fast','-Dcpu=baseline','-Dstrip=true','--prefix',str(out/(kind+'-'+os)),'--summary','all']))
for name,opts in [('fast', ['-Doptimize=fast']),('no-debug',['-Ddebug=false']),('no-float',['-Dfloat=false']),('minimal',['-Dfloat=false','-Dfiles=false','-Dhelp=false','-Dtools=false','-Dimage=false','-Dgraphics=false','-Daudio=false','-Ddebug=false']),('linux-debug',['-Dtarget=x86_64-linux-musl']),('linux-fast',['-Dtarget=x86_64-linux-musl','-Doptimize=fast'])]:
 jobs.append(('candidate',name+'-tests',['zig','build','test',*opts,'--summary','all']))
def run(job):
 kind,name,cmd=job
 with (out/(kind+'-'+name+'.log')).open('wb') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=out/kind,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'kind':kind,'name':name,'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode}
 if name.startswith('linux-') and name.endswith('-tests'):
  text=(out/(kind+'-'+name+'.log')).read_text(errors='replace')
  # Cross-test Windows runner cannot execute ELF; execute the exact generated test binaries through WSL.
  paths=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'failed command: "([^"\r\n]*test(?:\.exe)?)"',text)))
  paths=[str((out/kind/p.replace('\\\\','\\')).resolve()) for p in paths]
  paths=[p for p in paths if '.zig-cache' in p and Path(p).is_file() and Path(p).read_bytes()[:4]==b'\x7fELF']
  row['elf_tests']=[]
  for i,p in enumerate(paths):
   w='/mnt/'+p[0].lower()+p[2:].replace('\\','/')
   with (out/(kind+'-'+name+f'-elf-{i}.log')).open('wb') as log:t=subprocess.run(['wsl','--exec',w],cwd=out/kind,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   row['elf_tests'].append({'path':p,'exit':t.returncode})
  assert len(paths)==2,(name,text[-3000:])
  assert all(x['exit']==0 for x in row['elf_tests']),row
 else: assert r.returncode==0,row
 if name.endswith('-build'):
  os=name.split('-')[0];b=out/(kind+'-'+os)/'bin'/('sigma.exe' if os=='windows' else 'sigma');row['binary']={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':b.stat().st_size}
 return row
# Jobs share source-local cache: run sequentially to avoid test/build cache contention.
rows=json.loads((out/'validation.json').read_text()) if (out/'validation.json').exists() else []
for job in jobs:
 if any(x['kind']==job[0] and x['name']==job[1] for x in rows):continue
 row=run(job);rows.append(row);(out/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(job[0],job[1],row['exit'],flush=True)
